plain: The process of taking a dispute to court

webster.text: The act or process of carrying on a suit in a court of law or equity for the recovery of a right or claim; a judicial contest.

example.quote: The judiciary power of every government looks beyond its own local or municipal laws, and in civil cases lays hold of all subjects of litigation between parties within its jurisdiction, though the causes of dispute are relative to the laws of the most distant part of the globe.
